title: AI Voice Receptionist for Local Businesses
summary: The creator demonstrates an AI voice receptionist answering a call and booking details for a construction project. The creator notes clients are reselling these AI agents to local businesses for a setup fee and monthly retainer.
key_points: Clients are reselling AI voice receptionists to local businesses for a $2,000 setup fee and $500 a month.
The AI voice agent can handle greeting, service check, project scope, style and color choices, and caller details.
The AI agent in the video was built in about 15 minutes using Team Follow Up AI.
It connects directly into GoHighLevel (GHL) accounts, removing the need for n8n workflows.
The AI texts the business owner notes from the call so they can call back when free.
